# DATABASE ANCHOR

<!-- Generated by sdk-web <anchorPhase> on 2026-11-02 from [root/ai/] specs -->

v1 has no database. "Tables" are TypeScript types in /lib/types.ts with data in /content/*.ts.

Core types: StudioInfo, Musician, MusicianCredit, AboutSection, Festival, LineupSlot

Relationships:
Musician → MusicianCredit (nested credits[])
Festival → LineupSlot (nested lineup[])
LineupSlot → Musician (optional musicianSlug)

Ownership: all content is owned by the studio and edited in code.
Do not create Supabase tables or migrations until the admin phase is requested.
